facility.name: Colegio Bilingue Trinidad
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 1605 E EXPY 83, MISSION, TX, 78572

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Operation had a play structure with a broken piece (bridge). Note: This was corrected at inspection when broken piece was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Areas of the fence have peeling paint.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Four training certificates for three out of the six staff training records were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A total of 21 children ages 11mo-4yo were combined in the dinning room, Age difference of the youngest and oldest child in the room exceeded 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: Children in the dinning room waited 30 minutes with no activities while waiting for the rest of the breakfast to be prepared and served.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An employee was present at the operation without prior background check legibility notice.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider sent employee home pending background check eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: There were 21 children in the dinning room ages 11mo-4yo, The TV in the room was on and playing videos and one child was watching videos in a tablet
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: A completed Children's Products Certification form was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation moved the infant room to a room that used to be a toddler room prior to notifying Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: A diaper changing pad in the pre-k room was torn.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the diaper changing pad was replaced with a new pad.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A wooden fence picket was broken in the outdoor playground. The broken area of the fence was within children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was left caring for 6 infants in the infant  room when the second caregiver was observed outside of the center waiting for a school aged child being dropped off by the school bus. The ages of the children in the group were a 4 month old, a 6 month olds, a 10  month old, two 11 month olds, and a 12 month old.  According to the ratio chart the maximum number of children one caregiver may supervise is 4. The group was out of ratio by two childlren.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Ratios were not met in the cafeteria/multi-purpose room and the infant room. A caregiver was caring for 16 children of varying ages in the cafeteria/multi-purpose  room. The specified age of the children in the group was 2 years of age. According to the ratio chart the maximum number of children one caregiver may supervise is 11. The group was out of ratio by 5 children.    A caregiver was observed caring for 5 infants in the infant room. The ages of the children in the group were a 4 month old, a 6 month olds, a 9  month old, and two 10 month olds.  According to the ratio chart the maximum number of children one caregiver may supervise is 4. The group was out of ratio by one child.         Not: A second caregiver stepped into the room during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: A record was not available for review for a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The center did not notify Child Care Regulation about providing transportation services to chidren in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.04412(a) - Interference with an investigation: The operation staff interfered with the inspection when staff did not open the door for the inspector to enter the operation until after 8 minutes of knocking,  ringing doorbell and calling the operation's phone number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.04412(a) - Interference with an investigation (26 TAC §HRC42.04412(a) - Interference with an in)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Infants were served the afternoon snack on a bare table.        Note: This was addressed with the caregivers and a napkin was provided to place the snacks on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The person in charge of the center in the director's absence did not designate a second person in charge when they left the operation for their lunch break. When caregivers were asked who was in charge they provided a name of a staff member that was not present in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies reviewed were missing the following information:     (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;      (B) The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;      (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation;      (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place;       (E) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities; and        (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed asleep on a restrictive device for an undetermined amount of time.           Note: This was addressed during the inspection and the infant was moved to a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The ceiling in the pre-k room was observed with water damage. Several ceiling panels were observed with Yellowish-brown stains and black mold.      The wooden fence in the outdoor play ground was not maintained. Some parts of the wooden fencing were observed with peeling paint accessible to children.         NOTE: The ceiling panels were replaced during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 3 of 5 children's files reviewed were missing the authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment, and a statement of the child s special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 7 month old child was observed to have a nursing pillow placed under them while sleeping in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: The safety straps were not fastened for an infant using a floor bouncer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Child/caregiver ratios were not met in the infant room when a caregiver was caring for 5 infants. The specified age of the children in the group was 8 months of age. The child/caregiver ratio for children between 0-11 months of age is 4 children to one caregiver. The classroom was out of ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Two cribs were observed without a tight fitting sheet covering the mattress pad. The cribs were currently being used by children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A group of children including children under the age of 2  were watching television while waiting to be served their lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: The arrangement of the mats during nap time were positioned very close to each other and did not provide a walk and work space for caregivers between mats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the information gathered during this investigation, a caregiver left a group of children unsupervised when the caregiver in charge of the group stepped out of the room to go open the center's front door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered during this investigation, staff members demonstrated poor judgment when they served food that was too hot for young children.  As a result of this, a serious injury was sustained by a one-year-old child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation allowed a dance instructor to be regularly present at the operation and have direct access to children in care, prior to receiving notification of the dance instructor's background check eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A large branch that broke off a tree was observed  in the children's outdoor playground accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Three floor mats were not labeled with each child's name in the infant room.       NOTE: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the floor mats were labeled with a number and a number/child assignment list was created.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Four cribs and a play yard did not have a fitted sheet covering the crib's mattress.       Note: Sheets were provided for the four cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan reviewed was missing the specific procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments; and How children in attendance at the time of the emergency will be accounted for at the designated safe area or alternate shelter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was caring for a total of 7 infants in the infant room. The specified age of the children in the group was between 12-17 months. According to the ratio chart the maximum number of children a caregiver may supervise between the ages 12-17 months is 5. The group was out of ratio by two children.       Note: A second caregiver stepped in the classroom during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
